items.title: Lionel Reason Interview, 1981-05-26
items.q: During that time, Fetch Wilder's style was very popular. And I used to sing and play like him.

ctx.x: Oh yeah, I know him. Well, they had a band.

And the nighthawks on Roman and Kodai. And the club owner's name was Peter Tato, a tagging fella. And he had a color fella, was the manager named Peter Robinson from Mississippi. And I sat in with the band. During that time, Fetch Wilder's style was very popular. And I used to sing and play like him. And that first night I sat in with the band. And the manager called me on the side and asked me, I would like to work there. So I told him, Noah, he said, I'd like to make you the leader of the band. I said, well, I…
